source: CNWTileSetManager::ComputePathNodeInformation (0x3f3ea0), called under gdb for every letter and orientation 0-3; its output is ComputePathNodeRotation (0x3f3df0) applied to the built-in table. See engine/behaviour.md T15.
frame: Canonical tile frame of the walkmesh: metres, x east, y north, 0..10. The key under each letter is the path-node orientation 0-3 (the .set Orientation in degrees / 90, NODE rules).

fields.nodes: node positions (x, y); the region index of a node is its index here
fields.exits: exit points (x, y), all on the tile edge
fields.exit_node: for each exit, the index of the node that owns it
